title: Pricing Expert
locationText: Argentina, Colombia, Costa Rica, Mexico, Peru, Uruguay, Venezuela
description:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 9 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, conquistando mentes y corazones
Resumen del rol
Buscamos un Pricing Expert con experiencia en Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) para liderar el diseño, implementación y evolución de la estrategia de pricing de los productos de Cashea . Será responsable de desarrollar modelos de pricing que integren costos, riesgo, impuestos, condiciones de mercado, benchmark de competencia y objetivos comerciales para definir estructuras de precio rentables, competitivas y comercialmente viables.
Este rol trabajará de manera transversal con Comercial, Credit Assessment, Finanzas, Impuestos, Producto, Data y Engineering para asegurar que las decisiones de pricing maximicen el crecimiento del negocio, la rentabilidad del portafolio y la competitividad de la oferta.
Responsabilidades

• Diseñar y administrar el modelo integral de pricing para los productos BNPL, incluyendo tasas, comisiones, descuentos, plazos y estructuras de cobro.

• Desarrollar modelos financieros que incorporen costo de fondeo, pérdida esperada, costos operativos, impuestos, márgenes objetivo y variables de riesgo.

• Construir escenarios y simulaciones para evaluar el impacto del pricing en rentabilidad, volumen, competitividad y resultados financieros.

• Diseñar frameworks de pricing basados en valor, políticas de descuentos, arquitecturas de precios y reglas para pricing dinámico.

• Monitorear el mercado y realizar benchmarking continuo para identificar oportunidades de mejora y mantener la competitividad de la oferta.

• Desarrollar modelos analíticos que soporten las decisiones de pricing, incluyendo elasticidad de demanda, simuladores de rentabilidad, análisis de sensibilidad y herramientas de monitoreo competitivo.

• Consolidar los diferentes inputs del negocio en propuestas de pricing alineadas con los objetivos financieros, comerciales y de riesgo.

• Actuar como referente técnico de pricing para las áreas de Comercial, Riesgo, Finanzas, Producto e Impuestos, apoyando negociaciones, lanzamientos y decisiones estratégicas.

• Monitorear el desempeño real del portafolio versus las proyecciones del modelo, identificando desviaciones e impulsando mejoras continuas.

• Colaborar con Data, Engineering y Finanzas para automatizar los modelos de pricing e integrarlos en los procesos y sistemas de originación.

Requisitos

• Más de 4 años de experiencia en Pricing dentro de BNPL, banca de consumo, fintech de crédito o industrias afines.

• Experiencia comprobada desarrollando modelos de pricing y rentabilidad para productos financieros o de crédito.

• Sólido conocimiento de conceptos como costo de fondeo, merchant discount rate, APR, pérdida esperada, márgenes y estructuras de comisiones.

• Dominio avanzado de Excel (u otras herramientas AI) para modelado financiero y análisis de escenarios.

• Experiencia trabajando de forma transversal con equipos de Comercial, Riesgo, Finanzas e Impuestos.

• Alta capacidad analítica, orientación al negocio y habilidades de comunicación para traducir análisis complejos en recomendaciones accionables.

Deseable

• Experiencia específica en BNPL tradicional.

• Conocimientos en scoring crediticio, provisiones y gestión de riesgo de portafolio.

• Manejo de Python y/o SQL para análisis de datos y automatización de modelos.

• Experiencia presentando análisis y recomendaciones a audiencias ejecutivas y no técnicas.

• Inglés avanzado.

title: Staff Product Manager, Consumer Growth Loyalty
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About the role

Millions of people use the Affirm Card, but we don’t yet give them a reason to keep coming back beyond the product itself. You’ll build our consumer loyalty program from scratch: what people earn, how they move up, and why Affirm becomes their default way to pay.

What you’ll do

•
Own the vision and roadmap for Affirm’s consumer loyalty program, setting the hypotheses, success metrics, and sequencing across multiple quarters

•
Launch the first version of rewards and tiers, including earn mechanics, member benefits, redemption, and the surfaces that make the value obvious in app, at checkout, and after a purchase

•
Build the engagement loops (progress, milestones, personalized offers) that turn a one-time borrower into someone who reaches for Affirm every week

•
Own the program economics: reward liability, funding mix across merchant-funded offers, interchange and network incentives, and the case for incremental GMV against cost per member

•
Set up the measurement foundation for loyalty, including holdouts, incrementality testing and long-run LTV, then tune earn and burn rates and tier thresholds off what the data says

•
Partner with Risk, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Marketing to design rewards that are compliant and clearly disclosed, with no hidden fees or fine print that surprises people

•
Align senior stakeholders and pull together dependencies across Card, Shopping, Servicing and Marketing, leading embedded engineering and design pods through a lot of ambiguity

What we look for

•
8+ years in Product Management, with a track record in consumer mobile apps, fintech, or neobanks

•
Built or scaled a loyalty, rewards or engagement program: card rewards, points, tiers, subscription benefits, or something equivalent. You know earn and burn mechanics and what makes a program pay for itself

•
History of launching products from scratch, not just optimizing what already exists

•
Owned repeat usage, cohort retention or share of wallet as a primary metric, and know which levers actually move them

•
Comfortable building the financial model yourself and defending reward cost, funding mix and payback to Finance and leadership

•
Strong UX instincts and a high bar for design. You know the difference between a reward that feels good and a badge buried in a settings menu

•
Deep fluency in experiment design, incrementality/attribution, and LTV measurement; data chops (SQL/Amplitude-level self-serve) and a bias for shipping, learning and iterating quickly

•
Track record shipping consumer financial or regulated products; comfort partnering with Risk/Credit, Legal, and Compliance

•
Excellent cross-functional leadership, including experience leading without authority

•
AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and others to research, analyze and prototype, and help develop better product vision

•
Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience

Equity Grade - 13

title: Senior Account Director - 26307
description:
Why YOU Want This Job
At Enverus , we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.
We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.
The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.
Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus , and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.
We are seeking a dynamic and driven Account Director to join our Financial Services Sales Team and expand our footprint across the Private Equity sector.
Position Summary
The Account Director is responsible for generating new business and expanding existing customer relationships by selling Enverus SaaS solutions, data analytics, and subscription-based services to the financial services sector. The ideal candidate is a strategic hunter mentality with a track record in solution sales, preferably in oil/gas and power, SaaS, or data/analytics sectors.
Performance Objectives

• Own and drive the full sales cycle-from prospecting and discovery, proposal generation, contract negotiation & onboarding.

• Prospect and develop existing and new opportunities with financial services customers. Engage C-suite and technical buyers to identify business challenges and position Enverus solutions as strategic assets. Identify market opportunities, prospect for new clients, and develop strategies to penetrate these markets, focusing on the unique value proposition of the Enverus energy SaaS solution.

• Develop account plans to grow existing accounts. Working closely with retention.

• Accurately forecast, and consistently meet or exceed quarterly sales targets.

• Market Intelligence: Stay informed about industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities within the energy SaaS space.

• Leadership & Development - Collaborate with Analysts, Marketing, Business Development, Product Specialists, and Customer Success to deliver tailored, value-based solutions.

• Represent Enverus at regional industry events and conferences as needed.

• Product Knowledge and Expertise: Educate clients on the benefits and features of Enverus energy SaaS offerings and be able to effectively demonstrate their value proposition, often collaborating with sales engineers and technical support teams.

• Sales Performance and Reporting: Track sales data, analyze performance, prepare forecasts, and generate reports on sales activities and progress toward goals.

Competitive Candidate Profile

• Experience: Proven experience in SaaS and or financial services sales, ideally within the energy sector, with a track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.

• AI - Artificial Intelligence is a large part of the Enverus landscape. Practical knowledge and experience with AI.

• Sales Acumen: Strong sales skills, including prospecting, lead generation, negotiation, presentation, and closing deals.

• Evidence of creativity: “thinking outside the box,” will be key to success. Enverus has a Business Development and Marketing team at your disposal. How would you engage with them?

Job Opportunity: Transactional Corporate Attorney (Fully Remote!)
Our confidential client, an innovative corporate law firm based in New York City, is seeking an experienced Transactional Corporate Attorney to join their team. This fully remote role offers a unique opportunity to work in a collaborative, client-focused environment while enjoying the flexibility of remote work and top-tier compensation.
About the Role
As a Transactional Corporate Attorney, you will work on complex and rewarding projects, including fund formation, credit transactions, private equity and debt financings, mergers and acquisitions, structured equity investments, and other corporate matters. This role is ideal for candidates with BigLaw experience who are eager to take ownership of their work and client relationships while thriving in a flexible, entrepreneurial environment.
Key Responsibilities

• Provide legal counsel on private equity and debt transactions, fund formations, and structured equity investments.

• Handle early- and late-stage private equity investments, mergers and acquisitions, and general corporate matters.

• Build and maintain strong client relationships with a focus on their business growth.

• Collaborate closely with the team to deliver high-quality, efficient legal services.

Qualifications

• J.D. from an accredited law school.

• Admission to the New York Bar (Delaware Bar admission is a plus but not required).

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in transactional corporate law, preferably with BigLaw experience.

• Proven expertise in fund formation, credit transactions, and general corporate matters.

• Strong written, oral, and analytical skills, with a demonstrated business acumen.

• Self-motivated with an ownership mentality over client relationships.

Compensation & Benefits

• Competitive base salary of $250,000, plus generous performance-based bonus incentives.

• Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance reimbursements, 401(k) with maximum matching, and a tech budget.

• Monthly bonuses for leading deals, acquiring clients, and closing transactions.

Work Environment
This position is fully remote, enabling you to work from anywhere while staying connected through advanced communication tools. Our client values flexibility and views their remote-first approach as a strategic advantage over traditional law firms.
How to Apply
If youre ready to leverage your expertise in transactional corporate law while enjoying the benefits of a fully remote role, wed love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and cover letter.
Our confidential client is an equal opportunity employer, welcoming applicants of all backgrounds and characteristics as protected by law.

title: Employment, Counsel
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase .

As Employment Counsel on the Employment Legal team, you'll provide day-to-day employment law counseling and compliance support across Coinbase's global workforce of approximately 5,000 employees in 20+ countries. This team owns all aspects of global employment legal, from people relations counseling and employment agreements to HR compliance, employment litigation, and the emerging intersection of AI and employment law. You'll independently manage a counseling portfolio covering performance management, disciplinary matters, and exits while supporting employment agreements, HR compliance, and AI tool deployment compliance for the People team.

What you'll do:

• Own a people relations counseling portfolio, providing first-line legal support on performance management, disciplinary processes, accommodations, policy questions, and exits across the full company.

• Advise on international employment matters across our 20+ country footprint, partnering with outside local counsel and HR on cross-border questions, country expansions, and EMEA and APAC employee issues.

• Support employment agreement workflows, including offer letter review, standard separation agreements, transfer letters, and relocation agreements, working from established templates and escalating complex matters.

• Drive tactical compliance support for the People team's deployment of AI tools in recruiting and HR, reviewing specific tool deployments against Coinbase's AI employment law compliance framework, advising on bias audit obligations, and drafting required notices and disclosures.

• Partner with the People team on HR compliance matters, including EEO-1 reporting, OFCCP obligations, and pay equity compliance, contributing to the team's global compliance program as it expands in scope.

• Support employment litigation and administrative proceedings, including drafting EEOC position statements, coordinating with outside counsel, managing litigation holds, and assisting with discovery on active matters.

• Track employment law developments and turn them into practical guidance for HR partners.

Required Skills and Experience:

• J.D. with active U.S. state bar membership and 5+ years of employment law experience, including meaningful in-house experience advising HR business partners on the full range of employment matters.

• Strong U.S. advice-and-counsel experience across performance management, terminations, accommodations and leaves. Experience with hourly or customer experience populations is a plus. Experience counseling on international employment matters is a plus.

• Hands-on experience with employment litigation and administrative charges, including position statements, discovery, litigation holds and outside counsel coordination.

• Working knowledge of U.S. HR compliance requirements (EEO-1 reporting, OFCCP, pay equity) and demonstrated engagement with the emerging AI and employment law regulatory landscape.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Director, Partner Solution Engineer
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As Docker continues its rapid growth, we're seeking an inspiring and experienced Director of Partner Solution Engineering to lead a world-class team. Docker helps organizations solve complex challenges in modern software supply chains, security governance, and AI-driven development. This role offers the opportunity to shape how our strategic partners, including ISVs, CSPs, SIs, and VARs, adopt and deliver transformative technologies that make developers more productive and secure.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Partner Solution Engineering, you will lead a high-performing technical organization responsible for driving partner enablement, joint go-to-market initiatives, and technical excellence across Docker's partner ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with Partner Sales, Technical Alliances, Product, and Engineering to develop scalable technical partnership strategies that help partners successfully integrate, sell, and deliver Docker's platform. Your focus will be on enabling your team to drive partner technical readiness, co-innovation, and mutual customer success while building repeatable models for partner engagement at scale.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

LEADERSHIP & TEAM DEVELOPMENT

- Lead, develop, and inspire a team of Partner Solution Engineers, ensuring professional growth and high performance across multiple partner segments (ISVs, CSPs, SIs, VARs).

- Build and scale the Partner SE organization to support Docker's expanding partner ecosystem and geographic coverage.

- Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning focused on partner success and technical excellence.

- Coach, mentor, and empower your team to engage effectively with diverse partner organizations and communicate complex technical concepts clearly.

PARTNER ENABLEMENT & TECHNICAL STRATEGY

- Establish repeatable processes and programs for partner technical enablement, including scalable learning paths, certifications, technical deep-dives, and integration workshops.

- Design and deliver both 1:1 strategic enablement for key partners and 1-to-many programs that drive adoption across the broader partner ecosystem.

- Create technical content, integration guides, architectural diagrams, reference architectures, and enablement videos tailored for partners.

- Develop partner-specific technical sales plays, solution validation frameworks, and proof-of-value methodologies that highlight Docker's differentiated value.

JOINT GO-TO-MARKET EXECUTION

- Partner with the Partner Sales organization to drive joint account planning, co-selling opportunities, and "sell-with" and "sell-through" motions.

- Guide partners through solution design, technical validation, and evaluation processes to achieve joint customer success and sales goals.

- Support product positioning and technical validation during joint sales engagements, ensuring clarity on what's GA and ready for delivery.

- Define and track metrics for partner technical readiness, engagement quality, and revenue impact.

PRODUCT & ALLIANCE COLLABORATION

- Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share Voice of the Partner, influencing roadmap priorities and co-building initiatives.

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку Personal Assistant для C-level. Це позиція для впевненого фахівця з високим рівнем автономності, який гнучко перемикається між особистими й бізнесовими запитами керівників будь-якої складності - вміє миттєво оцінити задачу, знайти оптимальне рішення та довести його до кінця без нагляду.

Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі:
- Виконання задач від СЕО (від подарунків для бізнес-партнерів до організації складної логістики);
- Підтримка в особистих запитах;
- Допомога в організації ділових і особистих поїздок
- Допомога в організації командних та бізнес-подій (стратсесії, офсайти, зустрічі);
- Пошук інформації, аналіз та виконання ситуативних ad-hoc задач.

Що для нас важливо:
- Досвід від 2-3 років на посаді Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant або суміжній;
- Зрілість, автономність та вміння швидко розставляти пріоритети;
- Сильні ресерч-навички та гнучкість у нестандартних ситуаціях;
- Високий рівень комунікації та абсолютна конфіденційність;
- Рівень англійської: від Intermediate.

Буде перевагою:
- Досвід супроводу кількох керівників одночасно;

title: Senior Fullstack AI Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
Job description

For years, StackFuel has been one of Germany’s leading providers of data and AI training. Since early 2026, we have been part of Multiverse, Europe’s only EdTech unicorn and the continent’s largest AI upskilling platform. Together, we are pursuing a clear goal: to make 100,000 employees in Germany AI-ready and close the country’s data and AI skills gap.

To make this happen, we are building a next-generation adaptive learning platform from Berlin, AI-first from the ground up. Alongside this, we develop software tools and automations that integrate into our customers’ B2B platforms. As a Senior Fullstack AI Engineer (m/f/d), you’ll play a key role in shaping this platform and these software tools, from the database to the frontend. Your work directly reaches thousands of learners and contributes to the transformation of mid-sized and large German companies.

Your responsibilities

- Develop our adaptive, AI-first learning platform and software-based AI solutions end-to-end, independently making key technical architecture decisions

- Implement new features and requirements in our existing learning framework, balancing new development with ongoing improvements

- Build AI features into the platform, such as LLM-powered learning support, adaptive learning paths, or automated content generation, and ensure they run reliably, measurably, and cost-efficiently

- Build internal tools and AI automations for Learning Coaches, Client Operations, and Sales to help these teams work more efficiently

- Work closely with the entire engineering team, our Content Engineering team, and the Portfolio Leads

What you bring

- 5+ years of experience in full-stack development, several of them with senior responsibility (architecture, technical decisions, mentoring)

- You work AI-first and naturally use AI tools in your day-to-day engineering; the agentic SDLC isn’t a foreign concept to you but a target vision

- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs in products: prompt design, structured outputs, tool use, and evaluation of model outputs

- Experience with end-to-end development using Python (FastAPI or Django) and TypeScript/React

- Confident with PostgreSQL and schema migrations

- Discipline in testing and CI (e.g. pytest, typed code, GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience with Docker-based deployment and a foundation in observability

- Business-fluent English and ideally German at B1-B2 level

This role probably Isn’t for you if…

This role is probably not the right fit if you only want to work on greenfield projects. Alongside building our new platform, you’ll also continue developing our existing learning framework, and both are equally part of the job. It’s also not a good fit if you see AI tools as a nice extra rather than something that fundamentally changes how we build software. And if internal tools appeal to you less than the big product, you probably won’t be happy here: the back office for Learning Coaches, Client Operations, and Sales is a central part of the role, and it’s often where you’ll feel your impact most quickly.

What we offer

Work culture

A solution-oriented, data-driven way of working, an open feedback culture, and strong team spirit. Two Trustees, elected by the entire StackFuel team, act as a neutral, confidential point of contact for your questions and concerns.

Ownership

Take on responsibility from day one, actively contribute your own ideas, shape processes sustainably, and have a real influence on how we work.

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid model and are usually in our Berlin office 3 days a week.

Workation

Work from anywhere in the EU, the EEA, and Turkey for up to 10 days per year.

Room for exchange

Regular team exchanges, seasonal celebrations, and an always well-stocked kitchen make for a lively atmosphere.

Professional development

Take our online trainings to expand your skills and become an expert in data and AI.

title: Senior Accountant – Finance Operations (m/f/d)
description:
About us

EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets at the same time, are actively building our internal structures - and are looking for someone to help shape this growth phase.

Your role

You are our go-to person for day-to-day accounting. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place - cost center, account, country - and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. You ideally bring your own experience from a tax advisory firm or a similar environment.

Your responsibilities

 

● Preparatory bookkeeping: Pre-code receipts and prepare them for ongoing bookkeeping by our tax advisor

● Receipt and invoice management: Collect receipts and incoming invoices, review them, and consistently follow up on open items

● Correct allocation: Make sure expenses are assigned to the correct cost center and the correct account in the chart of accounts

● Travel expenses across Europe: Manage per diems (meal allowances), mileage allowances and comparable expense rules across countries for our teams in Europe

● Employees & freelancers across Europe: Know the Europe-wide controlling and accounting topics that apply to employees and freelancers - or get up to speed on them quickly

● International payroll interface: Manage local payroll providers and salary payments

● Cash flow: Think along on cash flow structures & reporting, and keep them up to date

● Process setup: Independently think through and set up finance processes and structures in an international, growing environment

What you bring

Must have

● 4+ years of professional experience in finance & accounting

● German at a fluent professional level (C1/C2), including German accounting and tax terminology; English at least B1, as our team is diverse and English is often the working language

● Very good DATEV skills and solid understanding of the chart of accounts and correct account assignment

● Flexibility with tools: you quickly find your way around other systems such as Odoo

● You have owned finance and accounting topics end-to-end, without day-to-day guidance

● You are comfortable in gray areas and make good decisions even without complete information

Nice to have

● Completed commercial vocational training or a degree with a focus on finance, accounting or controlling

● Understanding of how a balance sheet should be structured to be meaningful for investors - ideally through your own experience in a tax advisory firm or similar environment

● Exposure to controlling topics such as cost centers, forecasts or project margins

● Motivated, proactive and creative personality with a hands-on mentality - you want to shape things, not just administer them

Why EggAI?

● 100% remote work in an international, highly motivated team

● Flat structures and direct access to the Head of Finance and the founders - short paths, fast decisions

● Freedom to shape: you help build the finance infrastructure of an AI scale-up from the ground up

● Insight into one of the most dynamic growth fields in tech and into building a company across Europe

Sounds like you?

We'd love to hear from you!

If your profile looks like a good match we'll be in touch to organise a first stage interview.

Please note, due to the high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

title: Technical Account Manager

It connects 30+ inverter, battery and meter brands and covers 10,000+ sites in 35+ countries, many of them multi-vendor fleets.
We build the product with our customers, and their day-to-day problems set the roadmap (a missed outage, a savings report that takes a week to compile). In 2026 we launched Ray, an AI coworker that sits in Teams or Slack and answers questions about a customer's fleet in plain language. We're a small team, working remotely.
What you'll do
Onboarding (roughly 40% of your time)

• Run kickoff calls and collect what we need from each customer: site lists, vendor API credentials, PV orientation, target yield from PVsyst or Helioscope.

• Set up new organisations and assets in AMMP OS; connect vendor APIs, and data source selection.

• Configure and manage AMMP OS platform tailored to the customer's operation

• Test end to end before handover, then invite users and set their permissions.

• Work closely with other teams including but not limited to Software and Product Team.

Adoption and account health

• Track feature adoption and a health score for each account; we have a framework drafted and need someone to run it.

• Run quarterly check-ins with key accounts. Train users when adoption drops below target.

• Spot expansion: more MWp, an added module, Ray, the Data API.

Support

• Be the first point of contact.

• Triage data gaps, missing telemetry and billing questions; use our AI agents for first-line investigation and escalate the rest.

Renewals and feedback

• Feed recurring customer requests into the product backlog, with a clear write-up of who asked and why.

• Help us make onboarding faster. Today a 6-vendor customer takes about 10 hours of asset setup plus 20 hours of dashboard work; we want that number to fall.

What you'll bring
Must-haves

• 3+ years in customer success, technical account management or solutions engineering at a B2B SaaS company.

• Comfort with data. You can read an API response, write a basic SQL query, and spot when a number looks wrong.

• Clear written English; you'll write to customers in 35+ countries.

• You finish things. Onboarding has a lot of small steps, and missing one breaks the customer's first impression.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with battery storage, gensets or hybrid systems.

• Working knowledge of solar PV: you know what an inverter, PR and yield are, and why a site underperforms.

• Grafana, Looker Studio or a similar BI tool.

• Python or Jupyter notebooks for small data jobs.

• Familiarity with inverter portals.

• Experience in emerging markets, especially sub-Saharan Africa or Latin America.

• French, Portuguese or Spanish.

What we offer

• A real say in how customer success works here; you'd be building the playbook, not following one.

• Work that cuts emissions: every site we monitor is solar or storage replacing diesel or grid power.

• A team that already uses AI agents in daily work, so you spend less time on copy-paste setup.

• Remote work and flexible hours.

title: Head of Demand Planning & S&OP
description:
Forecasting at Rohlik currently drives operations across 12 fulfilment centres and 25,000 SKUs in five countries. Up until now, it has operated across local spreadsheets, individual judgement calls, and manual edits. It works, but it relies heavily on personal memory, lacks formal governance, and relies on manual routines.

As we continue to scale Europe’s leading online grocery delivery service, we are establishing Integrated Business Planning (IBP)/Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) as a brand-new Group department. The mission is to transform our current forecasting into an automated, governed, and scalable planning capability.

As Head of Demand Planning & S&OP, you will build this function from the ground up. You will own the Group demand forecast, establish the global S&OP cadence, build and lead the team, and work hand-in-hand with BI, Product, and Engineering to replace manual routines with modern, automated tooling.

Why this role is exciting

- Build from the ground up: This is a build role, not a position where you inherit an established setup. You will define the operating model, set governance across five markets, and recruit your own team.

- Direct C-level impact: You will stay close to the numbers daily, owning the daily forecast update delivered directly to the CEO, while framing strategic scenarios and trade-offs for executive decision-making.

- Automation & product ownership: Rohlik is an AI-first company. You will partner directly with BI and Engineering to automate planning inputs, create override logs, and launch automated plan-change notifications.

- Cross-functional authority: You won't just compile numbers. You will work at Director level to challenge Marketing uplifts, Commercial pricing, and Ops capacity, ensuring alignment across Commercial, Ops, and Finance.

- Multi-country scale: You will shape planning standards across all our active markets: the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania.

What you will own and deliver

- Build the department: Hire and develop the IBP/S&OP team, transition from single-person routines to a documented, resilient team structure with no single point of failure.

- Demand forecast & executive briefing: Own the Group demand forecast end-to-end and personally deliver the daily operational forecast brief to the CEO.

- S&OP cadence & operating plan: Establish the Group S&OP cycle, consolidating commercial, operational, and financial commitments into a single constrained operating plan.

- Governance & standards: Define planning responsibilities, KPI definitions, approval thresholds for manual adjustments, and escalation rules across CZ, HU, RO, DE, and AT.

- Automation roadmap: Act as the business owner for custom planning products, driving the rollout of mass uploads, automated locks, override logging, and instant plan-change alerts to Ops and Supply.

- Cross-functional alignment: Partner at Director level with Marketing, Commercial, Supply, Fulfilment, Last Mile, Finance, and BI, reconciling operational plans with financial outlooks.

- Forecast accuracy & stability: Drive plan attainment and forecast value added over statistical baselines, maintaining high forecast accuracy (targeting ≥ 98% on orders and orderlines).

What we are looking for

- Proven leadership in planning: 5+ years of progressive experience in Demand Planning, S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, or Supply Chain operational planning.

- Build track record: Demonstrated experience building or re-platforming a planning function from scratch - including team, processes, and tools.

- Automation mindset: Direct experience driving the automation of manual planning routines alongside BI, Data, or Engineering teams.

- Executive presence: Ability to distil complex, multi-market data into clear, concise updates for the CEO under tight deadlines.

- Multi-market oversight: Proven track record running S&OP or demand reviews across multiple countries, sites, or business units.

Director Job Description:
At Cloudera , we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
Pricing Strategy Director, AI Ecosystem Partners will be accountable for the overall coordination, strategic alignment, and commercial success of pricing and packaging across Cloudera ’s AI Ecosystem Partner products. This role focuses on defining commercial monetization models for partner solutions and driving high-growth commercial strategy initiatives.
Serving as a strategic partner and commercial force multiplier for AI Ecosystem and Product Leadership, this function requires an extremely proactive, market-savvy, and analytical leader who will ensure both optimal partner commercial structures and seamless pricing execution.
As a Pricing Strategy Director, AI Ecosystem Partners you will:

• Partner Packaging & Pricing Strategy: Formulate and execute strategies to price and package AI partner products, aligning commercial models with corporate growth goals of Cloduera.

• Partner Negotiations & Commercial Terms: Discuss and negotiate pricing terms directly with strategic AI partners, ensuring mutually beneficial economics, royalty structures, and sustainable long-term commercial agreements.

• Competitive Analysis & Positioning: Conduct comprehensive competitive analysis to establish optimal end-customer pricing, discount structures, and partner margins across the AI partner product portfolio.

• Operational Architecture: Design and plan required end-to-end commercial operations, including SKU creation, pricing operations, royalty reporting, billing workflows, and metering infrastructure for partner solutions.

• Ecosystem & Marketplace Building: Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Applied AI, Corporate Development, Finance, and Sales Operations to build scalable marketplace commercial frameworks and facilitate consumption-based monetization programs.

We’re excited about you if you have:

• 8+ years of experience in Pricing Strategy, AI Ecosystem Commercial Operations, Product Monetization, Partner / ISV Business Development, or Corporate Strategy.

• Prior experience in high-growth B2B tech, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, or AI software environments managing multi-product portfolios or partner integration models is highly preferred.

• Demonstrated proficiency in AI product monetization, including pricing framework design for artificial intelligence features, machine learning workloads, and token/usage-based models.

• Hands-on experience developing and managing consumption-based pricing and usage metering models alongside traditional subscription frameworks.

• Experience building or scaling software marketplace systems from a commercial and monetization perspective.

• Deep understanding of OEM agreements, re-sell commercial levers, royalty structures, revenue-share splits, and contractual terms with technology partners.

• Skillful at translating complex partner integration strategies into clear, actionable, and value-backed commercial options for field sales teams and partners.

• Strong capability to conduct competitive benchmarking, price elasticity modeling, and financial analysis to determine optimal end-customer pricing and margin health.

• Proficiency in navigating operational details including pricing operations, SKU setup, metering infrastructure, billing systems, and automated royalty reporting processes.

• Experience defining KPIs and tracking mechanisms to evaluate the long-term health, margin profitability, and adoption of strategic commercial programs.

title: Platform Support & Operations Team Lead
description:
Kevel is transforming the retail media space with its cutting-edge, AI-driven ad tech infrastructure APIs that power the Retail Media Cloud™. This groundbreaking solution combines the power of AI insights with API-based technology, allowing multi-brand retailers to build dynamic, customizable ad platforms while maintaining full control of their first-party data. With Kevel , retailers can deliver personalized shopper experiences, optimize ad targeting, and unlock predictive insights to stay ahead in an ever-evolving market.

JOB OVERVIEW : We are building a new Platform Support Team to serve as the dedicated first line of engineering support for our internal platform and we're looking for a leader to build it from the ground up. This team acts as the primary point of contact for internal engineering squads after customer-facing Technical Support, serving as the engineering escalation point for customer-facing support teams and as first responder for platform alerts.

As the Platform Support & Operations Team Lead, you will define, build, and lead this new function. You'll hire and develop a team of support and operations engineers, establish the processes and standards that make the team effective. Your leadership will help reduce toil across our 70-person engineering organization, enabling smaller, AI-augmented squads to focus on high-impact product and platform work. This is a player-coach role: in the near term you'll be hands-on alongside your team - doing triage, responding to incidents, and building runbooks yourself - while simultaneously establishing the processes and standards that make the function sustainable.

This is a high-visibility leadership role with real ownership: you'll directly improve platform stability and engineer productivity through hands-on operational work. In the near term, the team provides centralized support and operations. Over time, under your leadership, it will become the primary first-tier on-call engineering function for the platform (with domain squads retaining higher-tier on-call for complex issues).

LOCATION: REMOTE - HUNGARY. This position is 100% remote. Applicants located anywhere within Hungary are encouraged to apply. Applicants must be legally eligible to work within Hungary.

PAY TRANSPARENCY: Kevel uses external, third-party market data to determine compensation for all open positions. Our compensation philosophy is based on the candidate’s specific working location and experience level. This means that we will take a no negotiation approach in our recruitment and offer processes. We believe this is an important step in living our value of embracing diversity while underlining our commitment to fair, equitable and inclusive pay practices.

The pay range for this position is between HUF 24,500,000 and HUF 25,680,000. An exact offer for this position will be determined based on the candidate's working location and experience level, in relation to our existing team.

All compensation packages include the additional benefits as described in the 'Why you'll love working with us' section below. We also have a transparent ‘Total Rewards Philosophy’ we’d be happy to share with you which describes our overall approach to compensation and benefits in full detail! Our recruitment team can share more about this with you in an initial phone interview and will be happy to answer any questions you have related to compensation at Kevel !

• Coach and mentor team members on troubleshooting, incident response, and communication skills; conduct regular 1:1s and performance conversations.

title: Operations Manager- SAP and Cloud Services
description:
Position Summary
The Operations Manager / Project Manager serves as the central command point for service delivery across a portfolio of managed cloud customers, ensuring operational stability, consistent SLA performance, and high-quality execution across SAP and cloud environments. This role leads real-time incident management, including P1/P2 escalation handling, while orchestrating day-to-day operations such as patching, upgrades, change management, and ongoing managed services activities. Acting as the primary coordination hub across cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders, the individual drives structured execution, clear communication, and timely resolution of issues in a fast-paced, 24x7 environment. The role also partners closely with customers through executive reporting, performance insights, and continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging strong operational leadership, project management discipline, and accountability to enhance service delivery and optimize outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Lead P1/P2 incident management, including war room/bridge execution, triage coordination, and timely resolution Own incident communications and escalation management, ensuring clear executive updates, accurate trackers, and timely stakeholder alignment Monitor and enforce SLA adherence across ticket management, ensuring timely updates and resolution of high-priority issues Drive root cause analysis (RCA) completion within defined timelines and implement corrective and preventive actions Orchestrate end-to-end patch management, including scheduling, resource coordination, pre/post checks, and escalation handling Coordinate upgrade and change management activities (e.g., RHEL, HANA, platform upgrades), including daily ServiceNow (SNOW) oversight Act as the central coordination point across L1/L2/L3 teams, vendors, and stakeholders to remove blockers and ensure seamless execution Oversee operational readiness and managed services activities, including DR testing, system validations, monitoring, and alert management (e.g., FRUN) Support resource and operational management, including onboarding/offboarding, team availability, and capacity planning Lead customer engagement and continuous improvement efforts, including executive reporting (WSR/MSR/QBR), performance insights, and driving automation and process optimization Other duties as assigned
Qualifications

• Minimum 8+ years of experience in IT operations, managed services, or cloud operations, with at
least 3+ years in an operations leadership, project management, or incident management role

• Strong experience managing P1/P2 incidents in real-time, high-availability environments

• Solid understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, and Change Management

• Experience with ServiceNow and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and collaboration tools

• Strong understanding of SAP and cloud-based managed services environments

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive operational outcomes

• Demonstrated experience developing and implementing business frameworks and standard operating procedures

• Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, including executive-level reporting

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, prioritize critical work, and deliver within defined timelines in a fast-paced, 24x7 environment

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret operational data and drive actionable insights

• High resilience, adaptability, and accountability in high-pressure environments

• Alignment with RTS Core Values

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

As a Software Engineer on our Control Plane - Hosted team, you will be responsible for technical design and work in key functional areas of Elastic’s Cloud offerings. You will participate in coding, crafting solutions, debugging sophisticated failure scenarios, and prioritizing bug fixes and features. You’ll analyze the current system, its strength and limitations.

 

What You Will Be Doing

•
Guide cross-team technical designs and help create a team-wide high level architecture

Lead best practices for development, ensuring a reliable, scalable foundation and an engaging user experience for our customers

•
Contribute and lead technical plans and direction within our team and across other product teams in Elastic

•

•
Collaborate with other teams within Elastic. Examples include helping Support engineers in diagnosing problems or advising the Elasticsearch engineers with designing new features

What You Bring

•
5+ years of experience as a software engineer, with a track record of delivering high-quality code

•
Previous experience providing pragmatic technical leadership for a group of engineers

•
Knowledge of back-end languages such as Scala, Java or Go

•
Technical depth in one or more technologies relevant for SaaS (orchestration, networking, containers, etc.)

•
Passion for automation and quality

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary.  This role does not have a variable compensation component.  The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed. You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments

title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Boise, ID, USA
description:
Mission
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify 's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.
We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.
What Yo u’ ll Do:

• Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

• Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

• Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

• Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

• Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

• Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

• Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

• Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

• Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

• An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio - a rapidly evolving tech domain

Compensation: The United States base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000-$200,000 + bonus + equity depending on experience

title: AI Tooling Engineer - Remote
description:
About Us
At Zyte , we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte . Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 225 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.
For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
This role sits in Zyte 's Tooling team, working side by side with our Principal Engineer in Tooling on an internal agentic platform: one place that brings together what the company knows, today spread across many systems, so that people and their AI agents get that context in one place, each seeing only what they are allowed to see.
We are looking for a builder: someone who has built AI agents and shipped them to real users, and who likes owning a product end to end, from talking with the people who use it to the code, the deployment and the numbers that say whether it works. The first version is already in use inside the company and grows every week.
Roles & Responsibilities:

• Build the platform with the Principal Engineer in Tooling: new capabilities every week, from design to production.

• Connect new internal systems and SaaS tools to the platform: their APIs and data, how they fit a shared model, and who may see what.

• Build agents and the tools they use, including MCP servers that agents across the company can call, and the context they need to answer well.

• Own quality: evaluation sets and benchmarks, tracing, cost per answer, and fixing what users run into.

• Turn proofs of concept into internal tools that run in production in the cloud, with security and access done properly.

• Build with AI coding agents as the main way of working, with the specs, tests and reviews that keep the code sound.

• Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives: evaluating and standardising internal AI tools, cost and usage tracking, and agreed standards for AI-built internal apps; help other teams build on the platform.

• Talk with the people who use the platform, across the company, to learn what to build next, and explain what was built to technical and non-technical audiences.

Requirements

• 3+ years building and shipping production software, mostly in Python, with relational databases.

• Has built and shipped with LangGraph at least one agent that real people use: tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt and context design.

• Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from the main providers, cost and token optimisation.

• Hands-on with MCP or similar tool protocols, as a server and as a client.

• Evaluates AI systems properly: test sets, LLM-as-judge, regressions when a prompt or a model changes; tracing and observability with Langfuse or similar.

• Integrates APIs and data: SaaS APIs, SQL, data warehouses.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud and/or AWS): containers, managed databases, identity and access, CI/CD.

• Uses AI coding agents every day and knows how to keep their output in check.

• A sense for security and permissions: identity, least privilege, people see only what they are allowed to see.

• Comfortable with version control (GitHub/Bitbucket).

• Excellent written and spoken English, technical and non-technical.

Desired Skills:

• Familiarity with web data or web scraping.

• Django and Postgres, including vector search with pgvector.

• Enough frontend to build and change a chat interface (React, Next.js).

• Has built internal tools that colleagues adopted

title: Tour Staff Administrator
description:
About Us
Let’s go on an adventure together!
Hey there, we’re G Adventures . We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go - it’s about how it changes you.
For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.
At G Adventures , our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging - where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew - you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers - you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that - and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too - and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.
Now about that career of yours - this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? You get to do it all alongside a passionate, freakishly talented, one-of-a-kind bunch excited to produce top-notch work and spread a ridiculous amount of goodness at the same time.
Feel like this could be the right fit? We think so too, and we’re already way too excited to meet you.
The Tour Staff Administrator provides administrative and operational support to the Tour Operations team, ensuring that systems, documentation, travel logistics, communications, and operational processes are maintained accurately and efficiently. The role is responsible for supporting Tour Staff (CEOs) and the wider Operations team through effective coordination, record management, routine reporting, and logistical administration, contributing to the smooth delivery of tours across the region.
Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Administration & Document Management

• Compile, verify, and organize all pre-trip documentation, ensuring accurate filing for Tour Staff (CEO) access.

• Maintain compliance records, including passports, driver's licences, first aid certificates, background checks, and expiry tracking.

• Update Tour Staff (CEO) Code of Conduct records, contact profiles, and operational databases as directed.

• Maintain and audit physical and digital filing systems, transaction records, receipts, and payment documentation.

Systems Administration

• Maintain and update the internal Tour Staff (CEO) website and resource portals with current itineraries, trip planners, and operational documentation.

• Create, manage, and archive Tour Staff (CEO) Slack channels for tours, ensuring standard pre-trip information is available.

• Upload approved Tour Staff schedules into internal systems (e.g. Polaris).

• Support routine system administration and maintain accurate operational records.

Travel Logistics & Financial Administration

• Coordinate routine travel arrangements for Tour Staff (CEO) relocations, including flights, accommodation, and ground transfers.

• Coordinate the release and distribution of Tour Staff (CEO) swag in collaboration with the Workshop Manager.

• Assist the Finance team with invoice sorting, data entry, and administrative processing as required.

Communication & Operational Support

• Compile and format content for the regional monthly newsletter using information supplied by the Operations team.

• Distribute standard customer feedback reports to suppliers on a monthly basis.

• Publish Tour Staff (CEO) recognition and evaluation "Shout-Outs" on internal communication platforms.

• Participate in the emergency phone rotation, providing after-hours support on a scheduled weekly basis.

Event & Inventory Coordination

• Provide administrative support for internal meetings, staff training, engagement

Position Summary:
Do you love to smash your goals? Kindsight is seeking self-motivated team members with sales in their DNA!

What You’ll Do:

•
Experience with outbound prospecting

• You love connecting with people, through the phone, text, social media, email.

• You can learn new technologies

Company Overview

Imagine Everything. Build the Future with Hexion.

This is where bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators come together to shape what’s next. Your Future Starts Here.

If you’re ready to push limits, reimagine what’s possible, and create the extraordinary, Hexion is where you belong.

Anything is possible when you imagine everything.

Position Overview

The Principal Industrial AI Data Architect is responsible for designing and governing the data architecture that enables reliable, scalable AI across industrial environments.

This role ensures that:

• Data pipelines are aligned with the canonical semantic model

• Features used in AI models are consistent across training and runtime

• Industrial data is structured for real-time inference and long-term analytics

This role is the bridge between data, semantics, and AI execution.

Job Responsibilities

1. Define Industrial Data Architecture for AI

Design end-to-end data flows from:

Edge systems → cloud → AI pipelines → edge inference

Define:

• Data storage patterns (time-series, relational, event-based)

• Data movement and transformation strategies

Ensure architecture supports:

• Real-time processing

• Batch analytics

• Model lifecycle integration

2. Design Feature Pipelines and Delivery for AI Models

Design and govern the pipelines, storage, and lifecycle that build and deliver features to AI models, based on canonical definitions established by the Principal Manufacturing & Semantic Architect.

• Define feature engineering pipelines for both training (cloud) and inference (edge) environments

• Ensure consistency between training datasets and runtime inference data

• Prevent feature drift and data mismatch through automated validation

3. Integrate Semantic Model with Data Pipelines

Translate canonical semantic definitions into:

• Physical data models

• Schemas

• Pipelines

Ensure all data structures conform to:

• Enterprise standards

• Platform contracts

Additional Job Responsibilities

4. Enable Scalable AI Model Integration

Define data interfaces required by:

• Internal AI teams

• External model providers

Support:

• Model versioning

• Feature compatibility

• Performance validation

5. Design for Multi-Tenant and Product Use Cases

Ensure data pipelines and access patterns support multi-tenant environments, including:

• Customer data isolation and secure access controls

• Scalable onboarding of new tenants and use cases

• Reuse of data pipelines across customers and deployments

Note: The underlying data model for multi-tenancy is governed by the Principal Manufacturing & Semantic Architect.

6. Collaborate Across Teams

Partner with:

• Principal Manufacturing & Semantic Architect (canonical model definition and feature semantics)

• Principal Edge & OT Architect (edge data ingestion and inference data requirements)

• Platform Engineering (implementation and infrastructure)

• AI/Data Science teams (model requirements and validation)

Ensure consistent execution across domains.
